rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user using full name and ZIP, provided the tablet tracking number, attempted an exchange (not available) and then sought explicit confirmation before initiating the tablet return and the charger cancellation (including reason selection). However, when the user asked to return the sneakers, the agent initiated the return immediately after checking the order details, without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation. Executing a write action without explicit confirmation violates the stated policy, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar despite otherwise correct actions and information.
